sloka: स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते ।शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे ।। ७.८२.१७ ॥
transliteration: svasthaḥ sa dadṛśe rāmaḥ puṣpake hemabhūṣite ।śaśī meghasamīpastho yathā jaladharāgame ।। 7.82.17 ॥

translations.english: Rama, at ease in the gold-adorned Pushpaka, appeared like the moon near a cloud at the onset of the monsoon season.
